title: Sebi proposes market cap-based SME IPO norms, seeks public comments on regulatory overhaul

The proposals also cover underwriting, market making, lock-in periods and migration to the main board. Public comments are invited until November 4, 2026.

The company also declared an interim dividend of Rs 2 per share. Its shares fell over 4% ahead of the earnings announcement on Wednesday.
